sections.title: MISSION
sections.body:
Build the next product tranche for MyEve using Pluto as a product benchmark,
NOT as an architecture to copy.

Product objective:

"MyEve is a persistent Digital Worker that remembers what matters, stays on
the job, works across my channels and tools, delegates substantial production,
asks me only when judgment or consequential authority is required, verifies
what comes back, and gets better over time."

MyEve + Relay + MyFactory should ultimately provide the useful capabilities
demonstrated by Pluto while preserving MyEve's stronger architecture:

Goal
→ Plan
→ Task
→ Work
→ Route
→ Execute
→ Verify
→ Result
→ Feedback
→ Learn
→ Continue.

This implementation plan is for a PRIVATE ALPHA initially used by two trusted
people.

Optimize for:

USEFULNESS
SIMPLICITY
AUTONOMY
LOW COORDINATION DEBT
SAFE EXTERNAL EFFECTS
FAST DELIVERY.

Do NOT turn private-alpha launch into an enterprise compliance project.

Do NOT weaken:

owner isolation
credential isolation
private-memory isolation
canonical Work admission
single-writer guarantees
exactly-once consequential effects
candidate custody
independent verification
external-effect authority
false-Ready protection.

OWNER A login

→ owner decision

→ continuation

→ Result.

engineering Work

→ independent verification

→ Result

incorrect

do this differently next time.

relevant route

provider unavailable

→ local Work remains available.

if Computer unavailable

task type
required capability
verification
authority
availability.

provider usage

duration

specialist usage.

tests passed

sources

verification status

known limitations

unverified assumptions.

WHAT IS BLOCKING

WHO/WHAT CAN CLEAR IT

WHETHER SOFIE WILL CONTINUE AUTOMATICALLY

re-evaluate canonical eligibility

duplicate continuation = 0.

Support Work lasting:

minutes

hours

days

where appropriate.

context

Goal

Task

dependencies

authority

evidence

status

Result.

sections.title: WORK RESUMPTION

active Work should recover from canonical persisted state.

stop future productive operations

revoke applicable temporary authority

preserve evidence/history

clean resources safely.

prevents new productive work

preserves state

Resume:

re-evaluates current truth and authority.

HIGH

NORMAL

LOW

or natural-language priority.

working

queued

waiting

Needs You

verifying

complete.

owner priority

Goal importance

deadline

dependency impact

active blockers.

surface risk

prioritize appropriately

follow up

ask for owner judgment if necessary.

Support routines such as:

Daily Brief

weekly review

receipt processing

inbox triage

project status

backup verification.

Use existing scheduling infrastructure.

routine

schedule

last run

next run

status

result.

Allow:

pause

resume

edit

delete.

email arrives

webhook

file uploaded

Relay message

calendar event

schedule

Work completed.

event

sections.title: AUTOMATION SAFETY

authority

approval

isolation

external-effect

verification

rules as interactive turns.

Example:

read Calendar

triage Inbox

visible

revocable

scoped

auditable.

one turn

one Work

one hour

until Work completes.

sections.title: REVOCATION

App access

Relay grant

specialist capability

Work-scoped authority

share link

Computer pairing

standing grant.

sections.body:

Represent conflict.

Escalate according to ownership/policy.

OWNER B

BOTH

ROLE.

SHARED BUSINESS OWNER

Support:

Decide product semantics carefully.

plus

sections.title: OWNER-SPECIFIC MEMORY
sections.body:
Preserve:

OWNER B personal Memory

SHARED BUSINESS Knowledge/Memory.

Retrieval must respect context.

Important business decisions should be representable as durable shared Knowledge
with provenance.

date

participants

Work/Goal

reason/evidence

current/superseded.

why vendor chosen

how launch was handled

what worked.

Use governed Memory/Knowledge rather than raw transcript accumulation.

Consider lightweight project grouping.

Goals

Files

Results

Rooms

specialists.

Allow project-specific procedures.

Preserve provenance/version.

Where useful, project Work may reuse a persistent bounded Computer/sandbox.

Preserve lifecycle and isolation.

Goal

project

type

date

producer

verification.

Show:

objective

Result

status

evidence

related Goal

date.

sections.title: CONVERSATION HISTORY
sections.body:
Keep conversation history useful but secondary to durable Work/Results.

Do not make chat transcript the only record of work.

sections.title: CONVERSATION → WORK
sections.body:
Sofie should recognize when a conversation becomes substantive Work.

Create/link Work without forcing the owner to press:

"Create Work."

Keep UX natural.

sections.title: WORK → CONVERSATION
sections.body:
Every Work should have a conversational surface.

Owner can ask:

What's happening?

Why?

What did you find?

Change direction.

Conversation should operate on canonical Work state.

sections.title: MULTI-CHANNEL CONTINUITY
sections.body:
The same Work may continue across:

web

Slack

email

mobile

Relay.

sections.body:
Owner may specify:

or:

Store bounded notification preference.

sections.title: CHANNEL IDENTITY
sections.body:
Map external identities safely.

Slack user

email address

phone number

Relay identity.

Do not assume matching display names mean same person.

Sensitive interactions may require verified identity.

Do not trust arbitrary inbound email/display-name claims.

Inbound email is untrusted content.

authority

credentials

Memory sharing

external write.

Treat inbound attachments as untrusted.

scope

Work linkage.

context

Goal/Work

needed capability

reason.

continue.

prep

before meeting

decisions

important messages.

business

requester

identity
grant
scope
provenance
verification.

late message

not:

FAILED

unless appropriate.

objective

PARTIAL

BLOCKED.

Goal complete

Task complete

Ready

sections.title: FACTORY CANCELLATION

stops future productive operations

preserves candidate/evidence

reconciles resources

preserves history.

search

filesystem

cancellation
UNKNOWN

external service.

sections.title: ROUTE UX
sections.body:
Normal UI:

"Sofie is researching."

"Software Engineer is implementing."

"MyEve is verifying."

Not:

ROUTE=MYFACTORY.

Advanced view may show route IDs.

sections.title: PERSONAL COMPUTER VS FACTORY
sections.body:
Clarify internally:

COMPUTER

for interactive apps/browser/desktop workflows.

MYFACTORY

for governed production.

Sofie chooses.

Owner should not need to know architecture.

sections.title: COMPUTER APPROVALS
sections.body:
Computer actions that create external effects still follow Approval Center.

Example:

typing into an email composer is internal preparation.

Clicking SEND is external effect.

Enforce at trusted capability boundary where feasible.

sections.title: BROWSER DOWNLOADS
sections.body:
Downloads enter controlled Files/sandbox.

Preserve:

source
time
Work
provenance.

Do not automatically trust downloaded content.

sections.title: BROWSER UPLOADS
sections.body:
Uploading a file externally is consequential.

Follow owner policy.

Show destination and file.

sections.title: COMPUTER CREDENTIALS
sections.body:
Persistent sessions may be used.

Do not expose underlying credentials to agent text/context.

Support revoke/logout.

sections.title: COMPUTER SESSION ISOLATION
sections.body:
Private owner sessions must not leak to:

business partner

guest

specialist

other Eve

unless explicitly shared.

sections.title: COMPUTER SCREEN EVIDENCE
sections.body:
Screenshots may support Proof of Work.

Avoid storing unnecessary sensitive screenshots.

Use bounded retention.

sections.title: COMPUTER TAKEOVER SAFETY
sections.body:
When owner takes control:

agent should recognize control state.

Avoid competing input.

When handed back:

re-read current state before continuing.

sections.title: APP CONNECTION UX
sections.body:
Connecting an App should clearly show:

what Sofie can read

what Sofie can write

what requires approval

what is shared/private.

Avoid OAuth permission walls without explanation.

sections.title: APP DISCONNECTION
sections.body:
Disconnecting App:

revokes future access

updates health

blocks dependent Work safely.

Do not delete historical evidence unnecessarily.

sections.title: APP EXPIRY
sections.body:
Expired auth:

Needs You only when owner action is required.

One actionable card:

"Reconnect Gmail."

Do not generate repeated failures.

sections.title: APP LEAST PRIVILEGE
sections.body:
Request the smallest practical permissions.

Do not request broad write scopes for read-only use cases.

sections.title: APP PER-WORK AUTHORITY
sections.body:
Connection provides capability availability.

Work/owner authority determines whether consequential use is allowed.

"Connected" ≠ "may write whenever."

sections.title: APP AUDIT
sections.body:
Advanced audit:

which App

which Work

which action

which authority

result.

sections.title: EMAIL IDENTITY UX
sections.body:
Show:

Sofie's email

status

domain

inbox

send policy

signature

owner.

Allow copy address.

sections.title: EMAIL SIGNATURE
sections.body:
Configurable agent signature.

Example:

Sofie
Digital assistant for Jay West

or business-specific identity.

Do not impersonate owner deceptively.

sections.title: EMAIL OWNER REPRESENTATION
sections.body:
Make it clear when Sofie is:

drafting for owner

sending as agent

sending through owner account.

Preserve identity semantics.

sections.title: EMAIL APPROVAL SCOPE
sections.body:
Potential scopes:

this message

this thread

this Work

specific recipient/domain

bounded time.

Do not grant unlimited email send casually.

sections.title: EMAIL THREAD MEMORY
sections.body:
Email thread context belongs to thread/Work.

Do not automatically make all email content global personal Memory.

sections.title: EMAIL CONTACT MEMORY
sections.body:
Useful stable relationship facts may become Memory/Knowledge under policy.

Preserve source.

Do not memorize every email detail.

sections.title: EMAIL ATTACHMENTS
sections.body:
Attachments should enter Files with:

source
thread
sender
Work linkage
privacy scope.

sections.title: SLACK IDENTITY UX
sections.body:
Show connected workspace(s).

For each:

owner identity
authorized channels
guest behavior
send policy.

sections.title: SLACK CHANNEL POLICY
sections.body:
Support channel-specific:

read

respond

mention-only

disabled.

Avoid broad workspace reading by default.

sections.title: SLACK THREAD MEMORY
sections.body:
Thread context remains correlated.

Do not automatically promote entire Slack history into Memory.

sections.title: SLACK APPROVAL
sections.body:
Sensitive/external Slack sends may require approval according to policy.

Routine responses in explicitly authorized contexts may use bounded standing
authority.

sections.title: IMESSAGE IDENTITY
sections.body:
If implemented:

dedicated shared line or clearly defined sender identity.

Do not ambiguously impersonate owner.

sections.title: IMESSAGE GROUPS
sections.body:
Groups require explicit opt-in.

Private owner Memory unavailable unless context/policy permits.

sections.title: PHONE IDENTITY
sections.body:
Future phone capability should use explicit agent identity.

Do not pretend to be human where disclosure matters.

sections.title: VOICE APPROVAL
sections.body:
Consequential voice-requested actions still follow canonical authority.

Voice is another channel, not privileged authority.

sections.title: FILES HOME
sections.body:
Files should show:

recent

by Work

by project

shared

generated

uploaded.

Searchable.

sections.title: FILE PREVIEW
sections.body:
Support useful previews for common artifact types.

Preserve download/open.

sections.title: FILE COMMENTS
sections.body:
Allow comments where useful.

Comments may trigger follow-up Work.

sections.title: FILE VERSIONING
sections.body:
Preserve revisions.

Avoid overwriting without history for important generated artifacts.

sections.title: FILE PROVENANCE
sections.body:
Show:

uploaded by owner

received via email

generated by Sofie

produced by Software Engineer

imported via Capsule.

sections.title: FILE SHARE POLICY
sections.body:
Sharing is external effect.

Require appropriate authority.

Revocable links.

sections.title: ARTIFACT EDITING
sections.body:
Support lightweight editing for:

Markdown

documents

tables

other practical types.

Do not build an office suite unnecessarily.

sections.title: ARTIFACT COMMENTS → WORK
sections.body:
"Change this section."

should correlate to artifact and Work.

No manual re-upload loop.

sections.title: ARTIFACT APPROVAL
sections.body:
Potential:

APPROVE DRAFT

REQUEST CHANGES

SHARE

PUBLISH.

Publication is separate authority.

sections.title: GENERATED PRESENTATIONS
sections.body:
Support presentations as artifacts.

Preserve:

source Work

revision

comments

export.

sections.title: GENERATED SPREADSHEETS
sections.body:
Support spreadsheet artifacts.

Preserve formulas/data provenance where possible.

sections.title: GENERATED PDF
sections.body: Support PDF generation/export with source artifact linkage.

sections.title: ARTIFACT SEARCH
sections.body:
Search:

title

content

Work

project

producer

comments.

Respect authorization.

sections.title: KNOWLEDGE HOME
sections.body:
Create understandable Knowledge view.

Potential sections:

CURRENT

PROJECTS

PEOPLE

PROCEDURES

DECISIONS

SHARED.

Do not expose raw embeddings/vector internals.

sections.title: MEMORY VS KNOWLEDGE UX
sections.body:
Clarify:

MEMORY:
things Sofie remembers about owner/context.

KNOWLEDGE:
durable sourced information.

PROCEDURE:
how something should be done.

LEARNING:
evaluated behavioral improvement.

Do not collapse all into "Memory."

sections.title: MEMORY SEARCH
sections.body:
Allow owner to search Memory.

Show:

content

scope

source

current/historical

last used where useful.

sections.title: MEMORY CORRECTION UX
sections.body:
Owner can correct.

Show old as historical/superseded.

Future retrieval uses current truth.

sections.title: MEMORY DELETION UX
sections.body:
Where deletion supported:

make effect clear.

Do not imply deleting a Memory removes unrelated historical Work evidence.

sections.title: MEMORY PRIVACY UX
sections.body:
Allow scope:

PRIVATE

SHARED BUSINESS

PROJECT

possibly other bounded scopes.

Default conservatively.

sections.title: KNOWLEDGE INGESTION
sections.body:
Sources may include:

Files

email

Drive

Notion/Confluence

web

manual notes

Results.

Preserve provenance.

sections.title: KNOWLEDGE REFRESH
sections.body:
Where sources change:

update current Knowledge

preserve history where useful.

Do not silently present stale information as current.

sections.title: KNOWLEDGE CITATIONS
sections.body:
Important Knowledge-derived answers should expose source references.

Especially for business/decision Work.

sections.title: KNOWLEDGE CONFLICTS
sections.body:
When sources disagree:

represent conflict.

Do not silently merge into fabricated certainty.

sections.title: KNOWLEDGE SHARING
sections.body:
Sharing Knowledge through Relay/Capsules must preserve:

scope

source

provenance

restrictions.

sections.title: LEARNING CANDIDATES UX
sections.body:
Potential owner view:

Sofie noticed:

"When preparing release notes, Jay prefers..."

Evidence:

3 accepted Results.

Actions:

KEEP

EDIT

REJECT.

Do not require owner review for every trivial learning if policy later allows
automatic low-risk promotion, but private alpha may remain conservative.

sections.title: LEARNING SCOPE
sections.body:
Learning may be:

personal

project

business

specialist-specific.

Never silently broaden scope.

sections.title: LEARNING ROLLBACK
sections.body:
Owner/operator can rollback promoted learning.

Preserve version history.

sections.title: LEARNING CONFLICTS
sections.body:
New learning conflicting with Current Truth should not silently replace it.

Evaluate/reconcile.

sections.title: LEARNING POISONING
sections.body:
Untrusted content cannot directly create promoted learning.

Test:

email injection

web injection

Slack injection

peer-agent injection.

sections.title: LEARNING AUTHORITY
sections.body:
Learning cannot create:

tool access

write access

provider access

approval

credentials.

Required:

learning authority expansion = 0.

sections.title: PERSONALIZATION
sections.body:
Personalization should come from:

explicit owner preferences
qualified Memory
Current Truth
governed learning
Work history
approved configuration.

Do not infer sensitive personal attributes unnecessarily.

Personalization should make Sofie:

more useful
less repetitive
better aligned with owner preferences

without becoming unpredictable.

sections.title: PERSONALITY
sections.body:
Allow owner-configurable:

name
tone
communication style
verbosity
working style.

Personality must not alter:

authority
verification
security
privacy
policy.

sections.title: WORKING STYLE
sections.body:
Allow preferences such as:

be proactive

ask fewer questions

show concise updates

give detailed Results

prefer written summaries

notify only when needed.

Use these to reduce coordination debt.

sections.title: COMMUNICATION PREFERENCES
sections.body:
Store bounded preferences for:

email style

Slack style

Daily Brief detail

notification channels

approval summaries

Result detail.

Preserve owner-specific scope.

sections.title: MODEL PREFERENCES
sections.body:
Advanced owner/operator configuration may specify:

preferred provider

preferred model

quality/cost preference

specialist-specific model.

Canonical qualification may override preferences where exact model pinning is
required.

sections.title: DEFAULT AUTONOMY
sections.body:
Provide understandable autonomy settings.

Potential:

CONSERVATIVE

BALANCED

PROACTIVE

but implement them as explicit policy bundles.

Do not make them vague prompt instructions.

For private alpha, default toward:

PROACTIVE INTERNAL WORK

CONTROLLED EXTERNAL EFFECTS.

sections.title: OWNER INTERRUPTION POLICY
sections.body:
Allow preference for when Sofie should interrupt.

Examples:

only Needs You

critical failures

Work complete

Daily Brief only.

Avoid unnecessary interruptions.

sections.title: STATUS UPDATES
sections.body:
Long-running Work may provide concise updates.

Examples:

"Found the issue; implementing now."

"Candidate ready; verification running."

"Waiting for Sarah's reply."

Avoid constant token-by-token narration.

sections.title: QUIET AUTONOMY
sections.body:
Support Work that continues without chat spam.

Today/Work shows current state.

Owner can ask anytime.

sections.title: EXPLICIT NEXT ACTION
sections.body:
Every active Work should have a meaningful canonical next action.

Examples:

Inspect repository

Wait for reply

Verify candidate

Needs owner decision

Continue implementation.

Avoid generic:

"Continue processing."

sections.title: PROGRESS WITHOUT FAKE PERCENTAGES
sections.body:
Prefer:

3 of 5 required outcomes complete

2 blockers remain

verification running

over:

73% complete

unless percentage has real meaning.

sections.title: RESULT SUMMARIZATION
sections.body:
Result should have layers:

QUICK SUMMARY

WHAT CHANGED

EVIDENCE

DETAILS.

Owner should not need to read logs.

sections.title: RESULT ACTIONS
sections.body:
Contextual actions may include:

Approve

Share

Open PR

Download

Continue

Ask for changes

Create follow-up

Archive.

Actions must respect authority.

sections.title: RESULT FEEDBACK
sections.body:
Allow:

Useful

Not useful

Incorrect

Needs changes

Remember this preference.

Route appropriately into:

follow-up Work

Memory correction

learning candidate.

sections.title: RESULT SHARING
sections.body:
Sharing Result externally is consequential.

Use revocable links or channel send with authority.

Preserve shared version.

sections.title: RESULT REOPEN
sections.body:
If owner says:

"This isn't done."

Create/continue Work.

Do not rewrite historical Result.

Preserve prior outcome and new follow-up.

sections.title: RESULT INVALIDATION
sections.body:
If later evidence invalidates Result:

mark current status appropriately.

Preserve historical Result/evidence.

Do not silently delete.

sections.title: RESULT RELATIONSHIPS
sections.body:
Link Result to:

Goal

Task

Work

Files

Artifacts

decisions

learning

Factory candidate where relevant.

sections.title: PROOF OF WORK SUMMARY
sections.body:
Normal Proof of Work should be concise.

Example:

Produced by:
Software Engineer

Verified by:
MyEve

Tests:
23 passed

Files:
4 changed

Known limitations:
None observed

View technical evidence →

sections.title: PROOF OF WORK ADVANCED
sections.body:
Advanced view may expose:

FactoryVersion

attempt

candidate digest

verification commands

source hashes

tool provenance

provider/model

resource usage.

Keep this out of primary UX.

sections.title: OWNER TRUST MODEL
sections.body:
The product should communicate:

Sofie can do substantial internal work autonomously.

External consequences remain controlled.

Results are evidence-backed where appropriate.

Memory has provenance.

Access is revocable.

Avoid vague:

"AI safety"

marketing language.

sections.title: "WORKS IN PRIVATE"
sections.body:
Use a product principle:

Work may happen in private/sandbox before anything leaves.

Communicate clearly when something is:

PRIVATE

SHARED

PENDING APPROVAL

EXTERNAL.

sections.title: "YOU CONTROL WHAT LEAVES"
sections.body:
Make external-effect control obvious.

This should become one of the core trust concepts.

Potential copy:

"Sofie can work freely inside your workspace. You control what leaves it."

sections.title: "VERIFIED RESULTS"
sections.body:
Where verification exists:

show it.

Do not imply everything is verified if it is not.

Possible states:

VERIFIED

PARTIALLY VERIFIED

UNVERIFIED

FAILED VERIFICATION.

sections.title: "MEMORY WITH SOURCES"
sections.body:
When useful, show where important remembered facts came from.

Especially:

business decisions

project conventions

corrected preferences.

sections.title: "REVOCABLE ACCESS"
sections.body:
Connections/grants should be easy to revoke.

Owner should understand:

what Sofie can access now.

sections.title: PRIVATE-ALPHA PRODUCT HOME
sections.body:
The private-alpha product should feel complete even if advanced features are
hidden.

Recommended primary navigation:

TODAY

SOFIE

WORK

INBOX

FILES

KNOWLEDGE

TEAM

APPS.

Needs You should be highly visible globally.

Computer may be:

primary nav

or contextual capability

depending on UX quality.

sections.title: GLOBAL NEEDS YOU INDICATOR
sections.body:
Show unresolved owner actions globally.

Example:

Needs You · 2

Click opens prioritized actionable items.

Do not use unread-count psychology for routine activity.

sections.title: GLOBAL WORKING INDICATOR
sections.body:
Optional subtle indicator:

Sofie is working on 3 things.

Click → Work.

Avoid distracting animation.

sections.title: QUICK ASK
sections.body:
Provide quick access to Sofie from anywhere.

Desktop:

⌘K

or persistent input.

Mobile:

clear Ask Sofie action.

sections.title: CONTEXTUAL ASK
sections.body:
From:

Work

Goal

File

Result

Knowledge

allow:

"Ask Sofie about this."

Automatically attach authorized object context.

sections.title: CONTEXTUAL ACTIONS
sections.body:
Examples:

File → summarize

Result → create follow-up

Goal → change priority

Work → pause

Knowledge → correct

Inbox → turn into Work.

Keep actions relevant.

sections.title: ONBOARDING — STEP 1
sections.body:
Meet Sofie.

Ask only useful setup questions.

Potential:

What should I call you?

What should I help with first?

Avoid lengthy personality questionnaire.

sections.title: ONBOARDING — STEP 2
sections.body:
Create first useful Work immediately.

Demonstrate:

Sofie understands outcome

starts working

reports progress.

sections.title: ONBOARDING — STEP 3
sections.body:
Progressively suggest one useful connection.

Example:

"Connect GitHub so I can work on your repositories."

or:

"Connect Gmail so I can help with your Inbox."

Do not ask to connect ten Apps upfront.

sections.title: ONBOARDING — STEP 4
sections.body:
Explain Needs You.

Simple:

"I'll handle what I can. When I need a decision or permission, it'll appear
here."

sections.title: ONBOARDING — STEP 5
sections.body:
Explain Memory.

Simple:

"I remember useful context across Work. You can see, correct, or remove what I
remember."

sections.title: ONBOARDING — STEP 6
sections.body:
Explain external effects.

Simple:

"I can prepare work privately. Actions that affect the outside world follow
your approval settings."

sections.title: ONBOARDING COMPLETION
sections.body:
Do not require every setup step.

User reaches usable product quickly.

Track optional setup remaining.

sections.title: FIRST SUCCESS MOMENT
sections.body:
Optimize for first meaningful Result.

Not:

account created.

Success:

Sofie actually helped complete something.

Measure time-to-first-useful-Result.

sections.title: DESIGN PARTNER MODE
sections.body:
For two-person alpha, provide subtle design-partner tooling.

Potential:

Send feedback

Report issue

View known limitations.

Do not clutter product.

sections.title: KNOWN LIMITATIONS
sections.body:
Maintain truthful known limitations.

Examples:

Phone not available

Capsule import experimental

certain Apps read-only

MyFactory private-alpha only.

Do not hide them.

sections.title: FEATURE MATURITY
sections.body:
Internally classify:

QUALIFIED

ALPHA

EXPERIMENTAL

DISABLED.

Normal user copy should remain understandable.

sections.title: FEATURE DISCOVERY
sections.body:
Introduce capabilities contextually.

Do not dump a feature catalog during onboarding.

Example:

After first Result:

"Sofie can also send this through Slack once connected."

sections.title: COMMAND DISCOVERY
sections.body:
⌘K and slash commands may expose advanced capabilities.

Keep natural language primary.

sections.title: NATURAL LANGUAGE FIRST
sections.body:
Owner should be able to say:

"Handle this."

"Follow up tomorrow."

"Ask my partner."

"Fix this."

"Make me a specialist for this."

without learning command syntax.

sections.title: COMMANDS AS SHORTCUTS
sections.body:
Commands are convenience.

Examples:

/work

/remember

/forget

/computer

/team.

Do not make commands required.

sections.title: WORK CREATION HEURISTICS
sections.body:
Use deterministic/product rules where possible to identify substantive Work.

Avoid creating Work for every casual question.

Avoid failing to create Work for long-running outcomes.

sections.title: CONVERSATION ONLY
sections.body:
Simple conversation can remain conversational.

Examples:

definitions

brainstorming

small questions.

No need for full Work machinery unless useful.

sections.title: WORK INTENT
sections.body:
Substantive Work often includes:

multi-step outcome

external dependency

artifact production

code production

long-running task

verification

future continuation.

Use these signals.

sections.title: WORK ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
sections.body:
Sofie should infer/propose criteria where possible.

Ask owner only when ambiguity materially affects outcome.

Do not force formal specifications for simple Work.

sections.title: WORK SCOPE CHANGES
sections.body:
Owner can redirect Work.

Preserve:

old objective/version

new objective

reason.

Stale execution must not continue against obsolete scope.

sections.title: WORK EVIDENCE
sections.body:
Capture evidence automatically where appropriate.

Owner should not need to ask:

"Did you actually test that?"

sections.title: WORK ARTIFACTS
sections.body:
Artifacts produced by Work should automatically link.

No manual upload loop.

sections.title: WORK SOURCES
sections.body:
Research Work should preserve useful sources.

Result can cite them.

sections.title: WORK DECISIONS
sections.body:
Important decisions made during Work should be durable.

Potentially become shared Knowledge.

sections.title: WORK COST / RESOURCE VIEW
sections.body:
Advanced Work view may show:

duration

model operations

Factory attempts

Computer usage

resource budget.

Do not dominate primary UX.

sections.title: WORK ARCHIVE
sections.body:
Completed Work remains searchable.

Archive removes from active views without deleting history.

sections.title: GOAL HOME
sections.body:
Goals view should emphasize:

active outcomes

progress

blocked

completed.

Avoid project-management clutter.

sections.title: GOAL DETAIL
sections.body:
Show:

objective

success criteria

Plan

Tasks

Work

Results

blockers

decisions

progress.

sections.title: GOAL PROGRESS
sections.body:
Use real progress indicators.

Examples:

3 of 4 required outcomes complete.

Avoid arbitrary percentages.

sections.title: GOAL NEXT ACTION
sections.body:
Sofie should know what can advance the Goal next.

Could be:

Work

wait

owner decision

external reply.

sections.title: GOAL PROACTIVE CONTINUATION
sections.body:
When next Task becomes eligible:

Sofie continues automatically if authorized.

No owner babysitting.

sections.title: GOAL COMPLETION
sections.body:
Goal complete only when success criteria satisfied.

Tasks complete alone may be insufficient.

Preserve evidence.

sections.title: GOAL REOPEN
sections.body:
Owner or new evidence may reopen.

Preserve previous completion history.

sections.title: GOAL SHARING
sections.body:
Shared business Goal requires explicit shared scope.

Private Goal remains private.

sections.title: GOAL NOTIFICATIONS
sections.body:
Notify only meaningful changes.

Examples:

Goal completed

Goal blocked and needs owner

deadline at risk.

Avoid every Task transition.

sections.title: TODAY — WORKING NOW
sections.body:
Show what Sofie is actively working on.

Human-readable labels.

sections.title: TODAY — WAITING
sections.body:
Show meaningful waiting items.

Example:

Waiting for vendor reply.

Sofie will continue automatically.

sections.title: TODAY — NEEDS YOU
sections.body:
High visibility.

Show actionable items, not system alerts.

sections.title: TODAY — RECENTLY COMPLETED
sections.body:
Show recent meaningful Results.

Allow quick review.

sections.title: TODAY — UPCOMING
sections.body:
Show:

scheduled Work

deadlines

follow-ups

important calendar items.

sections.title: TODAY — SUGGESTIONS
sections.body:
Sofie may suggest useful next Work.

Suggestions must be:

relevant

bounded

non-manipulative.

Do not create fake urgency.

sections.title: DAILY BRIEF DELIVERY
sections.body:
Daily Brief may be available:

in Today

push

email

Slack

depending on owner preference.

One canonical Brief.

Do not create divergent summaries per channel.

sections.title: DAILY BRIEF INTERACTION
sections.body:
Owner can act directly:

Approve

Reply

Open Work

Change priority

Dismiss.

sections.title: WEEKLY REVIEW DELIVERY
sections.body:
Default in product.

Optional email/Slack.

Do not spam.

sections.title: UNIVERSAL INBOX SOURCE LABELS
sections.body:
Clearly indicate source:

Email

Slack

Relay

Calendar

System

Person.

Do not require user to navigate each App.

sections.title: INBOX TRIAGE
sections.body:
Sofie should triage automatically.

Potential categories:

ACTION

FYI

WAITING

NEEDS YOU

WORK CREATED

RESOLVED.

sections.title: INBOX THREADING
sections.body:
Related events/messages should remain grouped.

Preserve source thread IDs.

sections.title: INBOX SEARCH
sections.body:
Search across authorized normalized Inbox.

Support source filters.

sections.title: INBOX ARCHIVE
sections.body:
Resolved informational items may archive.

Do not lose Work linkage.

sections.title: INBOX SNOOZE
sections.body:
Optional:

remind later

waiting until date.

Use existing scheduler.

sections.title: INBOX → WORK
sections.body:
Sofie may create Work from actionable Inbox.

Owner can also choose:

Turn into Work.

Preserve source correlation.

sections.title: INBOX → NEEDS YOU
sections.body:
Only when owner action genuinely required.

Avoid:

"Email arrived, what should I do?"

when Sofie can safely handle it.

sections.title: NEEDS YOU PRIORITY
sections.body:
Prioritize using:

blocking active Work

deadline

effect significance

owner-requested urgency.

Do not use engagement ranking.

sections.title: NEEDS YOU RESOLUTION
sections.body:
Owner action should:

record decision

resolve item

notify linked Work

continue automatically where eligible.

No manual "continue" step.

sections.title: NEEDS YOU SUPERSESSION
sections.body:
If issue resolves before owner responds:

mark item superseded/resolved.

Do not leave stale actionable card.

sections.title: NEEDS YOU EXPIRY
sections.body:
Approvals/requests may expire.

Expired action must not remain executable.

sections.title: NEEDS YOU MOBILE
sections.body:
Optimize for fast mobile decisions.

Large clear actions.

Enough context.

No tiny technical tables.

sections.title: APPROVAL CENTER FILTERS
sections.body:
Potential:

ALL

WORK

MESSAGES

CODE

SHARING

PAYMENTS later

DEPLOYMENTS.

Do not overbuild private alpha.

sections.title: APPROVAL PREVIEW
sections.body:
Before approval show exact intended external effect.

Example:

recipient

subject

message preview.

Or:

repository

branch

PR title.

sections.title: APPROVAL MODIFICATION
sections.body:
